sqlquery.from:
(select distinct cc.title as title, coalesce(cc.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(cc.lastname,'') as employeeName, cc.dateofbirth as dateofbirth, ad.address as address, ad.city as city, acc.name as companyname, cc.jobtitles as jobtitle, cc.position as position, h.value as homephone, m.value as mobile, w.value as workphone, website.value as website ,
email.value as primaryemail , ep.salaryamount as salaryamount, ep.employmenthistory as employmenthistory , (co1.name ||', '|| lo.city) locationName ,cf.string_value1 employeetypes
from "$".employee ee left join "$".employeeprofile ep on ee.id=ep.employeeid left join "$".crmcontact cc on ep.contact_id=cc.id left join "$".address ad on cc.id= ad.contactid and entityType='contact' left join "$".crmcontactitemparams h on cc.id = h.contactid and (h.paramid = 1 and h.relationid =1) left join "$".crmcontactitemparams m on cc.id = m.contactid and (m.paramid =1 and m.relationid = 3) left join "$".crmcontactitemparams w on cc.id = w.contactid and (w.paramid =1 and w.relationid = 2) left join "$".crmcontactitemparams website on cc.id = website.contactid and (website.paramid =4 and website.relationid = 8) left join "$".crmcontactitemparams email on cc.id = email.contactid and (email.paramid =2 and website.relationid = 1) left join "$".crmaccount acc on cc.crmaccount = acc.id
left join "$".employee owneremploye on ee.id = owneremploye.id left join "$".position pos ON owneremploye.positionid = pos.id and pos.isDeleted is not true left join "$".employeelocation el on owneremploye.id = el.userid and el.deleted is not true left join "$".location lo on el.locationid = lo.id left join "public".country co1 on lo.countryid = co1.id
left join "$".employeecustomfields cf on ee.id=cf.id
) t
